method.permutation_filter: all permutations of 0,...,6 with one fixed point, one antidiagonal hit, and cycle type 1+3+3
method.scope_warning: The tangent certificate is local to the stated affine three-coordinate families.  Projection irreducibility and the bounded (x,y) screen do not prove global nonexistence or positive genus.
method.triangle_edges: x joins singleton to first 3-cycle; y joins first to second 3-cycle; z joins singleton to second 3-cycle
method.z_coverage: for each screened (x,y), every rational z is enumerated from linear factors of the specialized gcd; z is unbounded

purpose: Exact local obstruction and full-equation tests for three-coordinate Cayley triangle families through unsigned permutation Euler points

certificate.real_tangent_conclusion: The only common real tangent vector is zero: the diagonal form forces x=z=0, and then the nonzero y^2 coefficient in the antidiagonal form forces y=0.  The sequential tangent-cone criterion therefore makes the anchor an isolated real common zero.
